# Requirements Quality Checklist: Microservice Code Studio Architecture & QA Review

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness, clarity, testability, and constitutional compliance for Microservice Code Studio prior to technical implementation planning.
**Created**: 2026-09-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Ingestion & Specification Validation

- [ ] CHK001 Are schema validation requirements explicitly documented for both file upload and JSON REST payload ingestion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are specific error response structures and validation failure codes defined when an ingested specification lacks Given/When/Then scenarios? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the payload size limit and allowed file extension list explicitly specified for the web file upload mechanism? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define how conflicting or cyclic domain entity relationships are identified and rejected prior to generation? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Autonomous Generation & Sandbox Execution

- [ ] CHK005 Are the boundary criteria and timeout thresholds defined for each of the 3 self-repair iterations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the transition logic and diagnostic data structure to mark a session as "Blocked: Human Intervention Required" unambiguously specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Can the FIFO queue behavior and worker allocation mechanism be objectively verified under load? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are cleanup and resource reclamation requirements specified for Docker sandbox containers when builds fail or abort? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Real-Time Streaming & Resilience

- [ ] CHK009 Are event names, message payload structures, and reconnect retry intervals defined for the Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the state recovery protocol specified when a disconnected client reconnects using the Last-Event-ID header? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Can the latency requirement of "< 1 second for SSE progress updates" be objectively tested in an automated QA environment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements specified for graceful stream termination when generation finishes or encounters a terminal block? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]

## Code Exploration & Delivery Artifacts

- [ ] CHK013 Are directory hierarchy requirements for the file tree explorer specified to match the strict layered architecture? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the ZIP archive internal directory structure and root packaging format explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Are Git commit message formats and branch naming rules specified with testable conventional commit templates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Are fallback and error reporting requirements defined if the remote Git provider rejects a branch push or PR creation? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §User Story 4]

## Security & Constitutional Compliance

- [ ] CHK017 Are session in-memory lifecycle and memory purging requirements defined to ensure zero Git token leaks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the specification ensure total test isolation preventing outbound LLM API network calls during test execution? [Consistency, Constitution Principle VI]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
